title: Draft inspector
purpose: The new-task draft shown in the right preview panel before any database row exists. The user types an optional title, or uses "Start with" Note / Screenshot to create the task as "Untitled" and add content; Escape, the Discard draft button, or a click-away with no title drops the draft and writes nothing.

regions.name: Title bar (top, y 0-45)
regions.contents: Traffic-light window controls (close, minimize, fullscreen), drag handle, ProjectSwitcher showing 'Home', ListTabs with 'Errands' (selected) and 'Reading' and 'Garden', each with a Delete list close icon, a New list add button after the tabs, and on the right the Split view, Hide preview panel and Settings buttons. Bottom border at y~45. Chrome outside this screen.

regions.name: Task list pane (x 0-860, y 46-730)
regions.contents: Search bar pill (search icon, placeholder 'Search Errands', Search options button, vertical divider, New task button) and 8 task rows: 5 top-level (Pick up prescription with subtitle 'Counter closes at 6', Post the parcel to Mum done, Book bike service, Cut a spare key, Buy groceries for the week with '1 / 3' badge and expanded subtasks) and 3 subtasks under groceries (Oat milk done, Sourdough loaf, Apples). Each row has a round Select checkbox and a More button. Outside this screen.

regions.name: Footer (StatsBar, y 730-760, left pane)
regions.contents: Sort & filter button (tune icon), vertical divider, '2 / 8 done' stats label (rendered uppercase), thin progress bar about 25% filled, and the '25 %' label on the right.

regions.name: Draft header row (PreviewPanel > DraftInspector, top, p-4)
regions.contents: Accent caret bar at the left edge, empty completion ring placeholder, auto-growing title textarea (placeholder 'Untitled', focused on mount), breadcrumb row (folder_open icon, 'Home', '/ Errands' when a list is set), and the Discard draft IconButton at the top right. The whole panel is the DraftInspector root column (animate-rise, flex-1, min-h-0).

regions.name: Start with section (p-4 pt-0)
regions.contents: SectionHeader 'Start with' with a trailing rule, a row of two DashedButtons (Note with add icon, Screenshot with screenshot_monitor icon), then the muted helper paragraph 'Type a title, add a note, or take a screenshot — the task is created the moment it has something in it.'

regions.name: Window chrome and mounted containers (Resizer, SheetHost, Toast)
regions.contents: Resizer between the task pane and the preview panel (4x715 vertical handle at x 860, with a 1px vertical rule at x~860). SheetHost and Toast are mounted but hidden in both recorded states (new-task-draft and new-task-typed).

notes:
Merged from A (code-based) and B (screenshot and measurements). 49 entries total; no entry was dropped as a duplicate, and no whole entry was removed as wrong. Only conflicting values or behaviours were replaced, as listed below.

Conflicts and how they were resolved:
1. Completion ring (A: non-interactive 20x20 span; B: clickable 18x18 square checkbox). Kept A's component, size and non-interactive behaviour from the code. B's size is an image estimate and its click-to-toggle is unverified, so it was dropped.
2. Drag grip (B: drag to move window). A's code is pointer-events-none, so the drag behaviour was dropped and A's behaviour kept.
3. Discard draft (B: may be a collapse button). A's code shows runDraftAction('', 'cancel'), so the cancel behaviour was kept. B's collapse reading was dropped.
4. Breadcrumb values: A marked the project and list text as unknown. B observed 'Home' and '/ Errands' in elements.json, so those observed values are used.
5. Footer '25 %' label: A marked the text unknown; B observed '25 %' in elements.json, so it is used.
6. Dashed buttons: A's className h-10 (40px) conflicts with B's measured 35px height. The measured 35px is used as the look.
7. Helper paragraph: A's leading-4 (16px) conflicts with B's measured 14px line height. The measured 14px is used.
8. Round checkbox: B's aria-pressed=false applies to the Select (picked) state, not completion. The done states (t-post, t-milk) from A's tree are kept, so the two sources do not conflict.
9. Accent caret bar: A's code is h-4 w-0.5 (16x2px); B's values are image estimates (about 14px tall, 2-3px wide). Both are recorded in the look field.
10. Hide preview tooltip: tree.txt escapes the backslash. The shortcut is ⌘ followed by a single backslash.
11. Subtask title mapping: t-bread is 'Sourdough loaf' and t-apples is 'Apples', matched by row position in elements.json, not by name.
12. Footer sort control: A classed it as 'other'; B's element is a button, so the kind is icon-button. Component ViewControl kept from A.
13. Window controls: A's three Light entries (close, minimize, fullscreen) are kept as separate entries because each variant id differs. B's sources are added to each.
14. ListTabs split into a selected entry (Errands) and an unselected entry (Reading, Garden, count 2), which matches A's tone variants.
15. The 'Start with' header text box is 85px wide in elements.json and 291px in tree.txt. Both are recorded.

Not included: B's notes mention unrelated tool-output instructions about docs and tooling. They were not acted on and are not part of this inventory.
